result:
The phone bug is fixed and merged on `michael/dev` (commit `b0e536c42`). I couldn't send this to you directly, because `send_to_agent` was refused for `mastermind-voice-20261015`, so this is the reply.

- **Cause:** the dev socket only opens on `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `*.localhost`, as a security guard (`Socket.js:51`). On the LAN IP or the tunnel it is off, so `JSONL.live()` did one `fetch` and never updated. That also explains why the phone stopped at 17:56.
- **Fix:** off localhost, `Live.js` now reads only the new bytes of `page.jsonl` every 3 seconds while the tab is visible. It also reads again when the tab becomes visible or regains focus, and when the network returns or the page is restored. On localhost the socket stream is unchanged and resubscribes from its offset after a reconnect.
- **Order:** the feed is sorted strictly by time, newest first, and every card shows its time. A line with no `ts` sits at the last `ts` seen before it, then by line order. Nothing is dropped.
- **Verified headless at 400 and 1200 wide:** I loaded `/live/?poll`, which forces the phone path. I appended a card with no reload, and it appeared at both widths with no horizontal overflow. I did not test over the real LAN IP, because it isn't reachable from this machine.
- **Tradeoff:** off localhost this is a timer, which goes against the stream rule. A real stream there would mean opening the socket to the LAN.
